collection.title: Bentley Turbo R 1985 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Bentley Turbo R 1985 - 1999 model requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
